summary: Skeletal remains of an unidentified male (believed 25-50, 5'5"-6'0") discovered by teen hikers from the Conifer area in the Lost Creek Wilderness; authorities conducted a dog and grid search the next day, recovering a near-complete skeleton plus personal items (backpack, hiking poles, shotgun, phone); coroner estimated death about one year prior; still unidentified as of Feb 2022.
responding_agency: Park County Search and Rescue (recovery assist); Park County Sheriff's Office; Park County Coroner's Office
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — first-of-month; article says only 'June of 2021'. Distinct from id 3296 (Woodford remains, discovered June 2020). Discovery date used; coroner estimated death ~1 year prior. Inserted run 808 (The Flume chunk).
